name: open_url
description: Ask the person to open a link: a sign-in page, a bot to start. Show the label as a button that opens the url in a new tab or window (a channel sends the link); once it is opened, reply. The page opened is the provider's, never this one.

label.description: What the button says, e.g. Sign in with Google

opened.description: Whether the link was opened; true unless the person said otherwise
